Lucas [534] has proved that |an+1 | − |an | = O(njd ), √ where jd = 2p − 2, if p ≥ 1; jd ≤ 2p − 2 p if 41 < p < 1; and jd = − 12 , if p < 41 . The result for 41 < p < 1 is probably not sharp. artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let f be analytic in the unit disk D = {z : |z| < 1}. For p > 0, f is said to be mean p-valent in D if, writing n(R, f) for the number of solutions in D of f(z) = w (counted with multiplicity), one has
   (1/(2π)) ∫_0^{2π} n(R e^{iθ}, f) dθ ≤ p   for every R > 0.
Write the Taylor expansion of such f as f(z) = Σ_{n=0}^∞ a_n z^n.

It is known that for mean p-valent f in D,
   |a_{n+1}| − |a_n| = O(n^{j_d}),
where the exponent j_d may be taken as
   j_d = 2p − 2,                if p ≥ 1,
   j_d ≤ 2p − 2√p,              if 1/4 < p < 1,
   j_d = −1/2,                  if p < 1/4.

Problem. Determine the sharp value of the exponent j_d in the range 1/4 < p < 1; that is, find the infimum of all real numbers γ such that
   |a_{n+1}| − |a_n| = O(n^γ)
holds uniformly for every mean p-valent function f(z) = Σ a_n z^n in D, and decide whether the bound j_d ≤ 2p − 2√p can be improved.

(Related question.) For symmetric mean p-valent functions of the form
   f(z) = Σ_{n=0}^∞ a_n z^{an+b}   (a, b positive integers),
whose coefficients behave like those of a function which is mean (p/a)-valent, formulate and prove the analogous sharp bound on |a_{n+1}| − |a_n|. In particular, for a mean univalent function of the form
   f(z) = z + Σ_{n≥1} a_n z^{2n+1},
it is known that |a_{n+1}| − |a_n| = O(n^{1−√2}); decide whether this exponent 1 − √2 is sharp.
artifact.category_tag: Coefficient bounds for mean p-valent functions
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not return any reference establishing or refuting sharpness of Lucas's bound j_d ≤ 2p − 2√p for mean p-valent functions in the range 1/4 < p < 1, nor confirming sharpness of the exponent 1 − √2 for symmetric mean univalent functions f(z) = z + Σ a_n z^{2n+1}. The current status appears to be unverified in available online sources.

status_evidence.snippet: Survey of coefficient problems for univalent and multivalent functions; does not address sharpness of Lucas's bound for |a_{n+1}|-|a_n| in mean p-valent functions for 1/4<p<1.
status_evidence.claim: No mention of an improvement of Lucas's exponent j_d ≤ 2p − 2√p in the relevant range.
